Source: https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/5873f2c14efdb0f589b57c7739dd6709e463a8fa

Coverage: Actual diff inspected; related inverse/reland duplicate hunks checked as a chain.
Full small JSDoc diff plus historical/current DNS implementation. Historical worker-per-request Set retained live workers until finally; it did not explicitly terminate workers. Endpoint instead uses single module worker to serialize native C DNS calls and shutdown blocker. Later accepted correction679da6f5 is supplementary evidence, not range coverage.
